name: DustUp Arms Ultimatum
description:
The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.
